# uptimekuma_monitor_http (Resource)

Monitors an HTTP(s) endpoint, treating the response status code as the health signal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_monitor_http" "api" {
  name     = "API"
  url      = "https://api.example.com/health"
  interval = 60

  max_retries           = 3
  accepted_status_codes = ["200-299"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Friendly name shown in the Uptime Kuma dashboard.
- `url` (String) URL to request.

### Optional

- `accepted_status_codes` (Set of String) Status codes counted as success. Ranges are allowed, for example `200-299`. Default: `["200-299"]`.
- `active` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is running. Set to false to pause it. Default: true.
- `auth_domain` (String) Domain for `ntlm` authentication.
- `auth_method` (String) Authentication method: `basic`, `bearer`, `ntlm`, `mtls` or `oauth2-cc`. Leave unset for no authentication.
- `auth_workstation` (String) Workstation for `ntlm` authentication.
- `basic_auth_pass` (String, Sensitive) Password for `basic` and `ntlm` authentication.
- `basic_auth_user` (String) Username for `basic` and `ntlm` authentication.
- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) Token for `bearer` authentication.
- `body` (String) Request body.
- `cache_bust` (Boolean) Append a cache-busting query parameter to each request. Default: false.
- `description` (String) Free-form description of the monitor.
- `domain_expiry_notification` (Boolean) Notify before the domain registration expires. Default: false.
- `expiry_notification` (Boolean) Notify before the TLS certificate expires. Default: true.
- `headers` (String) Additional request headers, as a JSON object string. Uptime Kuma validates that this parses as JSON.
- `http_body_encoding` (String) Encoding of the request body.
- `ignore_tls` (Boolean) Ignore TLS/SSL certificate errors for this monitor. Default: false.
- `interval` (Number) Seconds between checks. Default: 60.
- `max_redirects` (Number) How many redirects to follow. Default: 10.
- `max_retries` (Number) How many times to retry before marking the monitor down. Default: 0.
- `method` (String) HTTP method. Default: GET.
- `notification_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the notification channels to trigger for this monitor.
- `oauth_audience` (String) Audience for `oauth2-cc` authentication.
- `oauth_auth_method` (String) How to present the client credentials: `client_secret_basic` or `client_secret_post`.
- `oauth_client_id` (String) Client ID for `oauth2-cc` authentication.
- `oauth_client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret for `oauth2-cc` authentication.
- `oauth_scopes` (String) Space-separated scopes for `oauth2-cc` authentication.
- `oauth_token_url` (String) Token endpoint for `oauth2-cc` authentication.
- `parent_id` (Number) ID of the parent group monitor. Use with `uptimekuma_monitor_group`.
- `proxy_id` (Number) ID of the proxy to send the request through, from `uptimekuma_proxy`.
- `resend_interval` (Number) Resend the notification every N checks while the monitor stays down. 0 disables resending. Default: 0.
- `response_max_length` (Number) How much of a stored response body to keep, in bytes. Default: 1024.
- `retry_interval` (Number) Seconds between retries after a failure. Defaults to the value of `interval`, matching the Uptime Kuma web UI.
- `save_error_response` (Boolean) Store the response body of failed checks, so notification templates can use `heartbeatJSON.response`. Default: true.
- `save_response` (Boolean) Store the response body of successful checks, so notification templates can use `heartbeatJSON.response`. Default: false.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags attached to this monitor. Uptime Kuma stores these as separate associations, so the provider reconciles them after saving the monitor itself. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `timeout` (Number) Request timeout in seconds.
- `tls_ca` (String) PEM-encoded CA certificate for `mtls` authentication.
- `tls_cert` (String) PEM-encoded client certificate for `mtls` authentication.
- `tls_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded client key for `mtls` authentication.
- `upside_down` (Boolean) Invert the result: a reachable service counts as down. Default: false.
- `weight` (Number) Sort weight in the dashboard; higher sorts first.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric ID of the monitor, assigned by Uptime Kuma.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Required:

- `tag_id` (Number) ID of the tag, from `uptimekuma_tag`.

Optional:

- `value` (String) Optional per-monitor value for the tag, for example an environment name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Monitors, tags, notifications and the rest are imported by their numeric ID,
# which is visible in the Uptime Kuma URL when you open the object.
terraform import uptimekuma_monitor_http.example 12
```
